items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: can be heard on recordings with Warren Vache

ctx.x: Frank Tate was born in Washington, D.C. on July 18, 1943. He started on trumpet but found his niche in the jazz world as a bassist. Frank played regularly with Marian McPartland and Dave McKenna in the ‘70s and toured with Pearl Bailey and the Louis Bellson Orchestra. He performs constantly at festivals here and abroad and can be heard on recordings with Warren Vache, Bobby Short and Butch Miles.
Frank was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 18, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
